scenario: Real accepted security work: depart Avel, run ordinary pilot ticks, save when a live interceptor interrupts the escort before its destination; legacy gunner saved after its real route reaches the work point.

journal.title: Landed on Avel
journal.text: Vaeli tideward towns rise between warm shoals. Most residents here are Vaeli; human neighborhoods and visiting crews share the dry quays. The local councils joined Kindred’s passage agreement without surrendering their own harbor laws.

journal.title: A ship of your own
journal.text: Kettle Station is behind you. The ship is held together by secondhand parts, but its next destination is yours. Dock to meet the people keeping Hearth alive.

crew.name: Captain Eni Ivara
crew.greeting: Finish the departure check and I’ll take us out. The work order is posted at your station.

crew.name: Oli Len
crew.greeting: I’ll keep the ordinary deck checks moving while you handle the posted work order.
